newsitem.title: UK: Provend sets UK flotation share price at 125p.
newsitem.headline: Provend sets UK flotation share price at 125p.

text.p: British vending services company Provend Group Plc said on Tuesday that it planned to float through a placing of nearly 10.87 million shares at 125 pence each, to raise a net 7.9 million stg.
Dealing in the shares is expected to start on November 18, and at the placing price the issue capitalises Provend at 21.6 million stg, the company said in a statement.
Institutional broker Henderson Crosthwaite is handling the flotation.

Provend's managing director Rufus Gunning said in the statement, "The listing will reduce gearing, provide additional resources to accelerate the organic growth of the group and will provide a capital base to give us the flexibility to take advantage of acquisition opportunities when they arise."
